title: IgnoreFriendlyHits - ObjectReference
content:
Member of: ObjectReference Script Flags this reference as ignoring (or not ignoring) friendly hits. In other words, it won't turn hostile after several hits from a friendly opponent. Syntax: Function IgnoreFriendlyHits(bool abIgnore = true) native Parameters: - abIgnore: Whether to ignore friendly hits or not. Default: True Return Value: None. Examples: ; Tells this reference to ignore friendly hits TempReference.IgnoreFriendlyHits()
; Tells this reference to no longer ignore friendly hits TempReference.IgnoreFriendlyHits(false) Notes: - It's been reported that this function doesn't account for hits which have secondary effects that deal damage such as explosions. See Also: - ObjectReference Script - IsIgnoringFriendlyHits - ObjectReference
